family_name: Autex Greenstuf Autex Soffit & Slab Liner

spec.description:
GreenStuf Autex Soffit and Slab Liner (ASL) is a high-density, Group 1
fire-rated 100% polyester insulation panel engineered for thermal and acoustic
lining of masonry, concrete slab, and metal pan soffits. Designed for exposed
and semi-exposed applications in commercial carparks, basements, and open-plenum
interiors, it enhances thermal resistance of the building envelope while
absorbing reverberant noise. Manufactured without chemical binders or
formaldehyde, ASL is non-toxic, moisture-resistant, and 100% recyclable with
circular takeback options.

install:
Check concrete slab is fully cured, clean, dry, and
free of oil, grease, or contaminants

Set out grid lines on the slab to align
panel joints neatly

Direct-fix using approved insulation masonry fasteners
and large washer heads (min 5-6 fixings per sheet)

Fasten fasteners at 100mm
from sheet edges and distributed evenly across panel centre

Butt-join panels
tightly to maintain thermal envelope continuity

Trim neatly around service
penetrations, pipes, and electrical conduits with a serrated knife
selection_checklist:
Confirm NCC Section J required R-value for the carpark
or suspended slab

Verify Group 1 fire rating requirement for exposed
ceiling/soffit linings

Select colourway (Flint light grey or Charcoal dark
grey)

Confirm slab fixing type (masonry drive anchors / insulation pins with
retaining washers)

Verify clearance requirements around mechanical and
electrical services
accessories:
Concrete/masonry insulation fasteners
with 50-75mm diameter retention washers
limitations:
Not intended for direct exterior weather exposure without
protection

Some minor colour variation across non-woven polyester batches is
natural

Panels compressed during freight require up to 72 hours to recover
full nominal thickness
spec.warranty:
10 Year Manufacturer's Guarantee
(50-year durability design life)

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex
GreenStuf Soffit & Slab Liner (ASL) is a high-density, Group 1 fire-rated
polyester insulation board designed for direct fixing to concrete slabs, masonry
ceilings, and metal pans. Available in thicknesses from 50mm to 100mm (R1.0 to
R2.5) in 1200mm x 2400mm panels, ASL delivers thermal performance for NCC
Section J compliance while simultaneously controlling sound reverberation in
commercial carparks and open basements. Non-toxic, moisture-resistant, and free
from chemical binders, it is available in light grey Flint or dark grey Charcoal
and backed by a 50-year durability design life.
